messages:
Ariana: FYI escalating a VIP 'Northstar' latency complaint — they see p99 jumps after the weekend deploy. p95 is okay (~120ms) but p99 hits ~1.6s in short bursts. sample req ids: req-abc123, req-def456. Can we triage?
Maya: Thanks — window and pool? Any recent autoscale/attach changes?
Ariana: Window 02:10-02:40 UTC. Dedicated pool dp-ny-eu-3. Config: min=2, max=20, autoscale-policy=default, warmup=0s (we relied on preboot previously). Deploy tag runtime:v2.4.0 on 2026-03-14 23:50 UTC.
Dave: I'll pull attach/attach_ready events. Quick thought: warmup probe behavior changed in v2.4.0 — we may be marking nodes ready before KV cache warmup completes, so first requests hit cold KV and inflate p99.
Lucas: Running log query now:
```
# query: attach events for dp-ny-eu-3
kubectl logs -l app=provisioner -n infra --since=1h | grep "dp-ny-eu-3" | grep attach
```
Log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z provisioner dp-ny-eu-3 attach start instance=i-0a1b2c
2026-03-15T02:12:15Z runtime dp-ny-eu-3 preboot ready instance=i-0a1b2c
2026-03-15T02:12:16Z runtime dp-ny-eu-3 kv_warmup complete instance=i-0a1b2c duration=3.2s
2026-03-15T02:12:16Z provisioner dp-ny-eu-3 attach complete instance=i-0a1b2c
```
Lucas: Those timestamps show preboot marked ready 1s before KV warmup finished. Requests routed during that 1s window — likely explains p99 spikes.
Maya: Is this new? Did v2.4.0 change readiness ordering?
Dave: Yes — change was to reduce ready latency by making the k8s readiness probe succeed after process start to reduce attach time. It assumed KV warmup is async and quick; on some models warmup is >1s and that gap hurts short tails.
Nora: Customer traffic profile: lots of short requests (few tokens) so the extra 1s is visible at p99 even if p95 unaffected.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created (priority=P2) and alerted oncall.
Maya: Mitigation ideas: (1) bump min pool to avoid cold attaches for this customer, (2) revert readiness probe change so probe waits for kv_warmup, (3) route this customer to a warm pool temporarily, (4) add a 2s traffic delay post-ready to allow warmup. Tradeoffs: (1)/(3) costy, (2) requires quick patch and rollout, (4) simpler but increases median.
Dave: Quick short-term: increase min for dp-ny-eu-3 from 2->4 and pin routing for Northstar to dedicated pool warm instances. Also add a transient prewarm job that does a KV touch on new instances. I'll push a change to infra to scale min.
Lucas: Commands I'm running now:
```
# scale the dedicated pool minimum (dry-run first)
redwoodctl pools update dp-ny-eu-3 --min-instances 4 --commit
# quick prewarm job
redwoodctl jobs run --pool dp-ny-eu-3 --image redwood/kv-warmup:stable --args "--touch-keys sample" --parallel 2
```
Lucas: Pushed prewarm job, verifying attach traces...
Ariana: Customer notified that we're investigating and applying mitigations (they requested updates every 30m).
Maya: Also recommend reverting readiness probe change in runtime:v2.4.0 and cut a v2.4.1 that gates ready on kv_warmup when pool type=dedicated. Dave, can you own the revert?
Dave: I can take revert + canary. Plan: revert probe change, build v2.4.1, schedule canary to 5% of new attaches in dp-ny-eu-3 in next 2 hours, monitor p99. If green, roll to 100% over 30m.
Nora: Watchouts: this will increase attach latency for new nodes slightly (adds wait), but should reduce p99 spikes in steady state. Need sign-off from cost/control.
Maya: Cost team ok with temporary min bump for the VIP. We should still estimate incremental $/hr.
Lucas: Observability update: after prewarm and min bump the p99 in the window dropped from 1.6s -> ~270ms. Live graphs: link https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/dp-ny-eu-3?range=15m (customer can view).
Ariana: Customer confirms fewer errors now, thanks. They're asking for postmortem and permanent fix timeline.
Dave: Tentative timeline: revert + canary today (2h), full rollout + config flag for warmup gating in 6h, postmortem doc in 24h. I'll create draft.
Maya: Repro steps for engineering to run locally:
```
# reproduce attach warmup gap
export POOL=dp-ny-eu-3
# simulate attach
provision-sim attach --pool $POOL --model big-embed --kv-latency 1200ms
# send 100 synthetic short requests at t=attach..attach+5s
ab -n 100 -c 10 http://routing-proxy.local/api/generate
```
Maya: Add that to the issue so QA can validate v2.4.1.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 updated: mitigation applied (min scaled, prewarm job run).
Ariana: Closing loop: customer happy for now, leave incident open until revert is rolled. Please post final postmortem and config changelog to #postmortems when done. :white_check_mark:
Dave: Will follow up with PR and rollout notes. Thanks team.
